meta.name: pattern-transfer
meta.description: Discover structurally similar patterns across domains, assess transfer viability via structural invariant checking, and propose domain adaptations with risk gates. Activate when Discovery identifies a problem that may have been solved in another domain.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现跨领域相似模式并评估迁移可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在不同领域寻找可复用的解决方案
copy.tagline_en: Discover structurally similar patterns across domains and assess transfer feasibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you seek reusable solutions across different domains

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析你描述的问题，从其他领域找到结构相似的现有模式，检查其能否安全应用到当前领域，并生成一份包含风险评估和调整建议的转移提案。
howto.when: 当发现的问题可能在其他领域已有解决方案，或 Claude 注意到已知模式与当前问题结构相似时触发。需要模式目录中已有至少3个不同领域的模式。

say.text: 帮我找找解决冷启动问题的跨领域模式。
检查一下仓储库存优化模式能否迁移到医院药品管理。
say.note: 指定源和目标进行转移检查

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes a described problem, finds structurally similar patterns from other domains, checks their transfer viability via structural invariants, and produces a transfer proposal with risk assessment and adaptation suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a problem is identified that may have been solved in another domain, or when a known pattern matches structurally to a new problem. Requires at least 3 patterns in the catalog from different domains.

say_en.text: Find cross-domain patterns for my cold start problem.
Check if warehouse optimization can transfer to hospital drug management.
say_en.note: Specifies source domain and target domain
